programs.name: Gymnastics with Caregiver
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on fun and safety, you will learn and practice basic skills such as walks, jumps, rolls and turns on various apparatuses. A caregiver must actively participate in this activity.

programs.name: Halloween Still Life: A Night of Painting
programs.description: Celebrate Halloween with an evening of painting, creativity, and a little spooky atmosphere. Working from a festive Halloween still life featuring pumpkins, candles, autumnal objects, and seasonal details, you’ll learn how to build a strong composition, explore colour and light, and capture texture and mood in paint.

programs.name: Hand Embroidered Pendant
programs.description: Combine the art of embroidery with  wearable design. Participants will learn how to create a miniature embroidered artwork and transform it into a unique pendant. Material fee of $20 (cash only) payable to instructor. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Hand Stitched Quilted Vest or Wall Hanging
programs.description: Design and  create either a quilted vest or a quilted  wall hanging using hand appliqué, layering, and simple quilting techniques in this five-week workshop. Work with fabric shapes, colour, pattern and  hand-stitching to build a personal textile piece. No sewing machine is  required, and patterns/templates will be provided, with room for participants  to develop their own designs. This workshop requires an  additional $30 material fee payable to instructor. *No  class on October 14

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). Learn comprehensive first aid training covering spinal injuries, heat/cold injuries, bone and joint injuries, burns, medical emergencies, and the proper use of automated external defibrillators.For information about attendance, withdrawals and refunds for courses offered with the Lifesaving Society, visit www.toronto.ca/recskills.

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED - Recert
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). This recertification course provides a review of first aid and CPR skills. programs.name: Intermediate Hand Built Planters & Vases
programs.description:
Make a functional planter or vase while
exploring a mix of hand-building techniques in this intermediate-level
workshop. Combine slab building and pinch forms to create a piece that’s both
practical and thoughtfully designed, encouraging problem-solving around
structure and form. The first classes focus on building your piece. After a
two-week break for drying and firing, the final class will focus on surface and
color. This is an intermediate level class and not suitable for beginners. *No class Nov 13 & 20

programs.name: Intermediate/Advanced Drawing & Painting
programs.description: Advance  your artistic practice through focused studies in expressive brushwork, colour  layering, natural textures and symbolic storytelling. Refine your understanding  of light, shadow, mark making and advanced composition, with an emphasis on  mastering colour mixing, creating cohesive palettes and achieving depth and  harmony in painting.

programs.name: Intermediate/Advanced Watercolours
programs.description: Develop a critical eye while experimenting with painting wet-in-wet, pouring colour, using multiple washes and learning to develop brush work techniques. Gain new skills in the areas of design and composition, as well as learn the roles that colour, texture and light play when creating with water-based paint.

programs.name: Intro to Hoop Embroidery
programs.description: Discover the art of hoop embroidery in this beginner-friendly  workshop! Participants will learn the fundamentals of hand embroidery,  including how to prepare a hoop, thread a needle and create a variety of basic  stitches. Through guided instruction and hands-on practice, you'll complete a  simple embroidered design. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Introduction to Airbrush
programs.description:
Explore airbrushing as a creative tool for visual
expression in this two-day workshop. Learn the fundamentals of airbrush
equipment, troubleshooting and basic techniques through demonstrations and
hands-on practice. Apply your new skills to create a finished canvas or
textile-based artwork using freehand and stencilling techniques. This workshop
requires an additional $50 material fee, payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Introduction to Punch Needle Rug Hooking
programs.description: Discover the art of punch  needle rug hooking in this fun, hands-on one-day workshop! Learn the basics of  the technique, including how to use the punch needle tool, set up your fabric,  and create textured loops. You’ll design and complete a small, personalized piece.  This workshop includes a $30 material fee payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Goal Setting with Photography
programs.description: Focus  on a life goal and explore how to get there. Using the technique of photo  elicitation, participants will reflect on past, present and future to make  their goal come to life. Participants should bring they own camera recording device such as an SLR, a  phone, tablet, etc.

programs.name: Group of Seven Landscapes

programs.name: Gentle Fit
programs.description: Seeking a class with a more relaxed pace to improve your fitness? Using gentle movements and low-intensity level exercises, workouts will include both  cardio and muscle conditioning options.

programs.name: Glass Mosaic
programs.description: Unleash your creativity and discover the art of  glass mosaic making in this hands-on workshop. Learn how to create a beautiful  mosaic butterfly, dog or ladybug by arranging colorful pieces of glass into  unique patterns. Material fee of $30 (cash only) payable  to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated  with the instructor.

programs.name: Glass Painting: Holiday Ornaments
programs.description: Discover the world of  glass painting in this engaging hands-on workshop! Learn how to transform plain  glass into stunning decorative artwork using the classic technique of black  outline painting to create two small ornaments. Material  fee of $30 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site  and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Glass Painting: Suncatcher
programs.description: Discover the world of  glass painting in this engaging hands-on workshop! Learn how to transform plain  glass into stunning decorative artwork using the classic technique of black  outline painting to create a bird-inspired suncatcher. Material  fee of $30 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site  and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Drawing and Painting
programs.description: Explore your creativity through pencils, pastels, acrylic paint and watercolours. Learn about and practice skills including sketching, shading, brush strokes and use of colour and texture.

programs.name: Drawing From Observation
programs.description: Develop  foundational observational drawing skills through guided exercises and extended  studio studies. Using still life objects, natural forms and simple drapery  arrangements, students will learn how to see like an artist by slowing down,  noticing relationships and drawing what they actually observe rather than what  they assume. This course is a natural next step for students who have completed  an introductory drawing course and are ready to deepen their observation,  accuracy, and confidence in drawing from life.

programs.name: Drawing: Portrait
programs.description: Portraits bring personality to paper. With basic instruction on how to draw your subject’s face and head, learn how to capture a subjects character in a variety of mediums such as pencil, charcoal, pastel and ink.

programs.name: Drawing: Portrait
programs.description: Portraits bring personality to paper. With basic instruction on how to draw your subject’s face and head, learn how to capture a subjects character in a variety of mediums such as pencil, charcoal, pastel and ink.

programs.name: Editing & Publishing
programs.description: Polish your  writing! Have stories sitting in a drawer or hidden away in the cloud? Ready to  take the next step toward publication? This three-week workshop will help you  transform previously written pieces into polished, submission-ready work.  Through guided editing exercises, constructive feedback, and hands-on learning,  you'll strengthen your self-editing skills, refine your voice and learn  techniques to make your writing stand out to readers and publishers alike.  Writers of all experience levels are welcome, and all creative formats, genres,  and project lengths are encouraged.

programs.name: Embroidery
programs.description: Come get an introduction to this handy skill. Learn how to read a pattern, cut material, stich by hand or use a sewing machine with the aim of completing a simple project.

programs.name: Expressive Florals: Through An Expressionist Lens
programs.description: See flowers as more than  botanical subjects – they become a vehicle for emotion, movement and personal  expression. Painting in acrylics, experiment with colour, expressive brushwork and composition to  create paintings that capture mood rather than realism. Inspired by Expressionist  artists, this course encourages creative exploration while developing  confidence in colour and visual storytelling.

programs.name: Family Fine Art (6 + yrs)
programs.description: Make  something great together! Build memories in this fine art course designed to  foster creativity, fun and connection between caregiver and child. Grow as  artists together through an exploration of paint, colouring media and collage, while  learning a variety of art making techniques. Both child and adult must  register separately.

programs.name: Family Pottery (11 + yrs)
programs.description: Get messy, get creative and  make memories in this fun, hands-on class where kids, teens and adults create  side by side. Learn simple clay techniques, make one-of-a-kind projects, and  enjoy time together – no experience needed, just creativity and curiosity! Both child and  adult must register separately.

programs.name: Fashion Sewing: Beginner
programs.description: Learn how to use a basic sewing pattern and a sewing machine to make a  pyjama pant or a skirt. By the end of the course, you will also create a sewing  sample binder and sewing worksheets to improve your sewing skills. This  workshop requires an additional $15 material fee (cash only), payable to  instructor for practice materials. Students  must bring their own fabrics. Materials  list will be provided.

programs.name: Fashion Sewing: Intermediate
programs.description: Bring  your own sewing pattern to make your own garment. By the end of the course, you  will also create a sewing sample binder and sewing worksheets to improve your  sewing skills. This workshop requires an additional $15 material fee (cash  only), payable to instructor for practice materials. Participants must bring their own sewing pattern, fabric, and  notions. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Figurative Drawing & Painting
programs.description: Develop  your observational skills while gaining an understanding of proportion and  basic anatomy in this drawing and painting course focusing on capturing the  human form from photographic reference. Using a range of techniques and mediums  such as charcoal, pencil, and acrylic paint, students will explore gesture,  contour and the principles of composition to effectively render the figure with  confidence and expression.

programs.name: Flat Reed Woven Star Ornament
programs.description: Weave a snowflake  using traditional techniques and reeds. In this one-day workshop, students will  create a large winter themed ornament that can be used as home décor or a great  holiday gift. This workshop requires an additional $30 materials fee (cash  only), payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Floral Still Life
programs.description:
Learn
fundamental composition methods and approaches through floral still life.
Starting with basic space and shape organization followed by value and colour
ratios, students will understand how to create flower drawings and paintings
with emphasis on visual interest and a strong focal point. Demonstrations will
also cover composing with colour harmony, approaching soft/hard textures, and
capturing floral glow and brightness.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Earrings
programs.description: Design beautiful unique glass earrings just for you. In this workshop, you will make three pairs of dichroic glass earrings including two pairs of studs and one pair of dangle earrings. Please bring $35 cash to the class for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Hello Fall!
programs.description: Be inspired by the breathtaking changing autumn  colours of Guild Park and Gardens to create a fall leaf decoration for your  friends and family. Material fee of $25 (cash only) payable  to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated  with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Holiday Ornament
programs.description: Decorate your own ornament  to be showcased on your tree for the holidays. Material  fee of $35 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site  and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Jewellery Set
programs.description: Decorate  a unique and vibrant set of jewellery for your individual style. Using colourful  glass pieces, you will design a matching set comprised of a pair of earrings  and a necklace. Material fee of $35 (cash only) payable  to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated  with the instructor.

programs.name: Goal Setting with Photography
programs.description: Focus  on a life goal and explore how to get there. Using the technique of photo  elicitation, participants will reflect on past, present and future to make  their goal come to life. Participants should bring they own camera recording device such as an SLR, a  phone, tablet, etc.

programs.name: Group of Seven Landscapes
programs.description: Explore the natural  beauty of Canada through the lens of the iconic Group of Seven in this two-week  workshop. Study the techniques, composition and expressive brushwork of these  early 20th-century Canadian painters while experimenting with texture, colour  and light.

programs.name: Halloween Still Life: A Night of Painting
programs.description: Celebrate Halloween with an evening of painting, creativity, and a little spooky atmosphere. Working from a festive Halloween still life featuring pumpkins, candles, autumnal objects, and seasonal details, you’ll learn how to build a strong composition, explore colour and light, and capture texture and mood in paint.

programs.name: Hand Embroidered Pendant
programs.description: Combine the art of embroidery with  wearable design. Participants will learn how to create a miniature embroidered artwork and transform it into a unique pendant. Material fee of $20 (cash only) payable to instructor. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). Learn comprehensive first aid training covering spinal injuries, heat/cold injuries, bone and joint injuries, burns, medical emergencies, and the proper use of automated external defibrillators.For information about attendance, withdrawals and refunds for courses offered with the Lifesaving Society, visit www.toronto.ca/recskills.

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED - Recert
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). This recertification course provides a review of first aid and CPR skills. Practical skills are assessed through scenarios and knowledge will be tested through a written evaluation.Prerequisite: Current Intermediate First Aid (CSA Z1210:24).For information about attendance, withdrawals and refunds for courses offered with the Lifesaving Society, visit www.toronto.ca/recskills.

programs.name: Intermediate Hand Built Planters & Vases
programs.description:
Make a functional planter or vase while
exploring a mix of hand-building techniques in this intermediate-level
workshop. Combine slab building and pinch forms to create a piece that’s both
practical and thoughtfully designed, encouraging problem-solving around
structure and form. The first classes focus on building your piece. After a
two-week break for drying and firing, the final class will focus on surface and
color. This is an intermediate level class and not suitable for beginners. *No class Nov 13 & 20

programs.name: Intermediate/Advanced Drawing & Painting
programs.description: Advance  your artistic practice through focused studies in expressive brushwork, colour  layering, natural textures and symbolic storytelling. Refine your understanding  of light, shadow, mark making and advanced composition, with an emphasis on  mastering colour mixing, creating cohesive palettes and achieving depth and  harmony in painting.

programs.name: Intermediate/Advanced Watercolours
programs.description: Develop a critical eye while experimenting with painting wet-in-wet, pouring colour, using multiple washes and learning to develop brush work techniques. Gain new skills in the areas of design and composition, as well as learn the roles that colour, texture and light play when creating with water-based paint.

programs.name: Intermediate/Advanced Watercolours

programs.name: Intro to Hoop Embroidery
programs.description: Discover the art of hoop embroidery in this beginner-friendly  workshop! Participants will learn the fundamentals of hand embroidery,  including how to prepare a hoop, thread a needle and create a variety of basic  stitches. Through guided instruction and hands-on practice, you'll complete a  simple embroidered design. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Introduction to Airbrush
programs.description:
Explore airbrushing as a creative tool for visual
expression in this two-day workshop. Learn the fundamentals of airbrush
equipment, troubleshooting and basic techniques through demonstrations and
hands-on practice. Apply your new skills to create a finished canvas or
textile-based artwork using freehand and stencilling techniques. This workshop
requires an additional $50 material fee, payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Introduction to Punch Needle Rug Hooking
programs.description: Discover the art of punch  needle rug hooking in this fun, hands-on one-day workshop! Learn the basics of  the technique, including how to use the punch needle tool, set up your fabric,  and create textured loops. You’ll design and complete a small, personalized piece.  This workshop includes a $30 material fee payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Drawing and Painting
programs.description: Explore your creativity through pencils, pastels, acrylic paint and watercolours. Learn about and practice skills including sketching, shading, brush strokes and use of colour and texture.

programs.name: Drawing From Observation
programs.description: Develop  foundational observational drawing skills through guided exercises and extended  studio studies. Using still life objects, natural forms and simple drapery  arrangements, students will learn how to see like an artist by slowing down,  noticing relationships and drawing what they actually observe rather than what  they assume. This course is a natural next step for students who have completed  an introductory drawing course and are ready to deepen their observation,  accuracy, and confidence in drawing from life.

programs.name: Drawing: Portrait
programs.description: Portraits bring personality to paper. With basic instruction on how to draw your subject’s face and head, learn how to capture a subjects character in a variety of mediums such as pencil, charcoal, pastel and ink.

programs.name: Drawing: Portrait
programs.description: Portraits bring personality to paper. With basic instruction on how to draw your subject’s face and head, learn how to capture a subjects character in a variety of mediums such as pencil, charcoal, pastel and ink.

programs.name: Editing & Publishing
programs.description: Polish your  writing! Have stories sitting in a drawer or hidden away in the cloud? Ready to  take the next step toward publication? This three-week workshop will help you  transform previously written pieces into polished, submission-ready work.  Through guided editing exercises, constructive feedback, and hands-on learning,  you'll strengthen your self-editing skills, refine your voice and learn  techniques to make your writing stand out to readers and publishers alike.  Writers of all experience levels are welcome, and all creative formats, genres,  and project lengths are encouraged.

programs.name: Embroidery
programs.description: Come get an introduction to this handy skill. Learn how to read a pattern, cut material, stich by hand or use a sewing machine with the aim of completing a simple project.

programs.name: Expressive Florals: Through An Expressionist Lens
programs.description: See flowers as more than  botanical subjects – they become a vehicle for emotion, movement and personal  expression. Painting in acrylics, experiment with colour, expressive brushwork and composition to  create paintings that capture mood rather than realism. Inspired by Expressionist  artists, this course encourages creative exploration while developing  confidence in colour and visual storytelling.

programs.name: Family Fine Art (6 + yrs)
programs.description: Make  something great together! Build memories in this fine art course designed to  foster creativity, fun and connection between caregiver and child. Grow as  artists together through an exploration of paint, colouring media and collage, while  learning a variety of art making techniques. Both child and adult must  register separately.

programs.name: Family Pottery (11 + yrs)
programs.description: Get messy, get creative and  make memories in this fun, hands-on class where kids, teens and adults create  side by side. Learn simple clay techniques, make one-of-a-kind projects, and  enjoy time together – no experience needed, just creativity and curiosity! Both child and  adult must register separately.

programs.name: Fashion Sewing: Beginner
programs.description: Learn how to use a basic sewing pattern and a sewing machine to make a  pyjama pant or a skirt. By the end of the course, you will also create a sewing  sample binder and sewing worksheets to improve your sewing skills. This  workshop requires an additional $15 material fee (cash only), payable to  instructor for practice materials. Students  must bring their own fabrics. Materials  list will be provided.

By the end of the course, you will also create a sewing  sample binder and sewing worksheets to improve your sewing skills. This  workshop requires an additional $15 material fee (cash only), payable to  instructor for practice materials. Students  must bring their own fabrics. Materials  list will be provided.

programs.name: Fashion Sewing: Intermediate
programs.description: Bring  your own sewing pattern to make your own garment. By the end of the course, you  will also create a sewing sample binder and sewing worksheets to improve your  sewing skills. This workshop requires an additional $15 material fee (cash  only), payable to instructor for practice materials. Participants must bring their own sewing pattern, fabric, and  notions. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Figurative Drawing & Painting
programs.description: Develop  your observational skills while gaining an understanding of proportion and  basic anatomy in this drawing and painting course focusing on capturing the  human form from photographic reference. Using a range of techniques and mediums  such as charcoal, pencil, and acrylic paint, students will explore gesture,  contour and the principles of composition to effectively render the figure with  confidence and expression.

programs.name: Flat Reed Woven Star Ornament
programs.description: Weave a snowflake  using traditional techniques and reeds. In this one-day workshop, students will  create a large winter themed ornament that can be used as home décor or a great  holiday gift. This workshop requires an additional $30 materials fee (cash  only), payable to the instructor.

programs.name: Floral Still Life
programs.description:
Learn
fundamental composition methods and approaches through floral still life.
Starting with basic space and shape organization followed by value and colour
ratios, students will understand how to create flower drawings and paintings
with emphasis on visual interest and a strong focal point. Demonstrations will
also cover composing with colour harmony, approaching soft/hard textures, and
capturing floral glow and brightness.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Earrings
programs.description: Design beautiful unique glass earrings just for you. In this workshop, you will make three pairs of dichroic glass earrings including two pairs of studs and one pair of dangle earrings. Please bring $35 cash to the class for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Hello Fall!
programs.description: Be inspired by the breathtaking changing autumn  colours of Guild Park and Gardens to create a fall leaf decoration for your  friends and family. Material fee of $25 (cash only) payable  to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated  with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Holiday Ornament
programs.description: Decorate your own ornament  to be showcased on your tree for the holidays. Material  fee of $35 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site  and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Jewellery Set
programs.description: Decorate  a unique and vibrant set of jewellery for your individual style. Using colourful  glass pieces, you will design a matching set comprised of a pair of earrings  and a necklace. Material fee of $35 (cash only) payable  to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated  with the instructor.
